text:
Now write SQL. Join hero_power → superpower (power_name = 'Super Strength') → superhero (height_cm > 200).

Note: "superheroes with the super power of Super Strength" — should count heroes. Note hero_power may have duplicates? Use DISTINCT hero_id to be safe.

Also height_cm = 0 or NULL means missing — exclude those. height_cm > 200 handles that.

Let me first check the power name exact match and count.

input.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS cnt
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Super Strength' AND s.height_cm > 200;

SELECT s.id, s.superhero_name, s.height_cm, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sp.power_name LIKE '%Super Strength%'
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC
LIMIT 40;
